narr: The combination of a stalled front and very slow moving upper level low combined with very deep Gulf moisture to generate rounds of showers and thunderstorms. Rainfall amounts of 4 to 12 inches fell across the area and led to numerous reports of flooding. Significant flash flooding was reported in parts of Escambia County AL, particularly from Brewton east to the Damascus area. The Murder Creek in Brewton crested in moderate flood stage at just under 27 feet on the morning of October 6th.
ev: Heavy rain caused Kennedy Street to be closed due to flooding.
Heavy rain caused flooding on Danne Road near the Fairhope community.
Heavy rain caused a few roads in Fairhope to be closed due to flooding.
Heavy rain caused flash flooding in and around Brewton.
Evergreen Avenue in Brewton is impassable due to flooding.
Foshee Road just west of Brewton has multiple spots that are impassable due to flooding.
Part of CR 69/Damascus Road was impassable due to flooding. A bridge was reported washed out on Damascus Road.
Partial road closure at US 29 and Ridge Road due to water over the roadway.
Significant flash flooding was reported in Brewton with numerous roads closed.
